mapper.select: SELECT STOCK_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, STOCK_NUM AS STOCK_QTY, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM mes_unqualified_stock WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, SPEC_MATERIAL_CODE AS MATERIAL_CODE, STANDARD_CODE AS STANDARD_LENGTH, STOCK_NUM AS STOCK, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM SPEC_STOCK_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND STOCK_DATE = #{stockDate} AND MATERIAL_CODE = #{materialCode} AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}
